questions.text: The job requires experience with serverless architectures. Can you describe a specific project where you designed and deployed serverless solutions? What were the performance metrics and cost savings achieved?
questions.strategic_intent: Validate hands-on serverless experience and quantify business impact
questions.evidence_gap: CV mentions AWS experience but lacks specific serverless implementation details

questions.text: You mentioned mentoring 5 junior engineers. What specific methodology did you use, and how did you measure their growth? What was the retention rate of your mentees?
questions.strategic_intent: Quantify leadership impact and demonstrate structured approach to team development
questions.evidence_gap: Mentorship mentioned but lacks specific outcomes and methodology

questions.text: The role requires optimizing systems for 5M+ daily active users. Can you walk through a specific scalability challenge you faced at that scale? What metrics did you track and what were the improvements?
questions.strategic_intent: Demonstrate experience at target scale with quantified results
questions.evidence_gap: CV shows 5M+ users but lacks detail on specific scalability challenges addressed
